title: Part sale line lookup does not offer an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an inactive part, part A, with 4 on hand and a hyphen in its part number.
  • Have an active part, part B, with 4 on hand, so the lookup has a part it must still offer.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, and descriptions that start with the same text, so one search finds both.
  • Create an open part sale for this test, part sale A, with no parts.
  • Start on part sale A's Parts tab (Parts in the top bar, Part Sales in the left menu, then part sale A).
custom_steps:
1. Click Add Part.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Part Number field.
  3. Replace the text with part A's part number in lower case.
  4. Close the part row without saving it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • A part row opens with a Part Number lookup.

Step 2:

  • Part B is offered.
  • No row for part A is offered: neither an inventory row with "Inventory Qty" nor a "Part Library" row.

Step 3:

  • The lookup shows part A's part number, written as it was saved (capitals and hyphens), followed by "is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.".
  • No offer to add the number as a special order appears.

Step 4:

  • Part sale A still has no parts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R8: “Part lookup on a part sale line does not return inactive parts.”
  • S9-R16: “When the number typed in a part lookup matches an inactive part at this location, the lookup does not offer to add it as a special order. It shows "{part number} is inactive. Activate it from the Inactive tab to use it.", naming the inactive part's number. On technician charge-out, where a typed number is taken straight from the field, the field shows the same message as its error and the line cannot be saved.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given GREASETUBE is inactive, when the user searches "GREASE" on a work order, estimate, part sale, purchase order or technician charge-out, then it is not offered, neither as an inventory part nor as a Part Library entry.”
